executive_summary:
This episode continues the host's allegation that a multinational operation involving France, the French Foreign Legion, Israel, and elements of the US government was connected to the September 10, 2025 assassination of Charlie Kirk, and that she is now a target of a French state-sponsored assassination plot. The evidentiary centerpieces are: (1) Candace Owens's November 25 X post (read in full), (2) a French Ministry of the Armed Forces denial that Tyler Robinson served in the French Foreign Legion, (3) a France 24 article that confirms one FFL–US Marines joint exercise but denies a Minnesota follow-on, (4) Andy Parrish's correction that "Camp Riley" is a typo for Camp Ripley, (5) a long source email providing an alleged French-American network across Wilmington, Delaware (anchored at 920 North King Street, the Bracebridge Complex, the du Pont family, Incyte, and the Wilmington Trust), (6) the Ace Partners website identifying Satys as a portfolio company, (7) Pavel Durov's public endorsement, and (8) a podcast clip and email involving the PBD/Adam Sosnick–Eric Bolling dispute.

The episode advances three investigative questions: (a) whether a French state assassination plot against the host was credibly conveyed and reported to US authorities; (b) whether French Foreign Legion personnel were on the ground at UVU on September 10, 2025; and (c) whether the Wilmington, Delaware legal forum of the Macron lawsuit is a substantive nexus for the alleged French-aligned infrastructure.

Most of the Wilmington-network claims rest on a single uncorroborated source email; they are inscribed as claim-anchored-to-email rather than as independently verified. The host's broader conspiracy framing (satanic power, gang-states, MK Ultra, federal setup) is not inscribed as claims per the rhetoric-removal test.

artifacts.bundle_name: Candace Owens X/Twitter Post (November 25, 2025)

sub_items.description: Full tweet asserting contact by "high-ranking employee of the French government" claiming the Macrons authorized and financed her assassination via a GIGN team including one Israeli operative; also asserts Charlie Kirk's assassin trained with the French Legion's 13th Brigade and identifies Xavier Poussard as also at risk

artifacts.bundle_name: Pavel Durov X Post

sub_items.description: Durov statement: "After reviewing everything Charlie Kirk has ever said about Macron's France, I find Candace's information about French involvement in his death entirely plausible. Charlie even called for 300% tariffs on France until the charges against me were dropped."

artifacts.bundle_name: Article by Freddie Ponton ("Freddie Ponton um Ponton" as read on air)

sub_items.description: "Past as Prologue, Safari Club Illuminates Candace Owens' allegations" – Ponton's framing paragraph characterizing Candace's allegation as resonating because of prior covert-operation history rather than trust in Owens; references Safari Club precedent.

artifacts.bundle_name: Wikipedia Entry – Safari Club (referenced as displayed on screen)

sub_items.description: Wikipedia paragraph describing the Safari Club as a covert alliance of intelligence services formed in 1976, with members including pre-revolutionary Iran, Egypt, Saudi Arabia, Morocco, and France; also referencing Israel, Djibouti, South Africa; and noting the 1979 Egypt–Israel peace treaty as a downstream process result.

artifacts.bundle_name: French Foreign Legion Training Deployment Record

sub_items.description: Per the French Foreign Legion website (host's reference): a 3-week training deployment between August 2 and August 25, 2025, integrating legionnaires of the 4th Company, 2nd Foreign Infantry Regiment (6th Light Armored Brigade) with US Marines of the 6th Marine Regiment in California.

artifacts.bundle_name: French Ministry of the Armed Forces – Official Statement

sub_items.description: Ministry of the Armed Forces statement: "Tyler Robinson was never part of the French Foreign Legion. If he did not serve in an American military unit, he could not have trained with the French Foreign Legion."

artifacts.bundle_name: France 24 Article

sub_items.description: France 24 article reporting that the Ministry of the Armed Forces confirmed the August 2–25 California training exercise with the 2nd Foreign Infantry Regiment and describing it as not clandestine; also reporting the Ministry formally denies a follow-on training exercise at "Camp Riley" in Minnesota because no Camp Riley exists.

artifacts.bundle_name: Andy Parrish X Post

sub_items.description: Andy Parrish, identified on air as "former chief of staff to the Republican state representative," posted that no Camp Riley exists in Minnesota; Camp Ripley does.

artifacts.bundle_name: Source Email on Wilmington, Delaware (read aloud by host)

sub_items.description: Section: French Street history – North French Street is the northern stretch of the original French Street, laid out as Willing Street in Thomas Willing's grid; renamed in the 1790s after a cluster of French-speaking refugees (many from Haiti and the French Revolution) settled along it.

Section: 920 North King Street, Wilmington – claim that three federal agencies work together in one building; identified in connection with a foreign dignitary escort and the attorneys filing the host's Brigitte-lawsuit paperwork.

Section: Bracebridge Complex at 1100 North King Street – originally built as Maryland Bank headquarters 1995; Bank of America acquired 2006 and pulled out of the buildings in 2018; in 2024 legislation was passed to provide financial support to the Longwood Foundation (founded by Pierre S. du Pont) to operate it as an educational center; complex spans six buildings connected to both French Street and King Street.

Section: Incyte Corporation – claim that the long-time CEO of Incyte was Hervé Hoppenot (host self-corrects: "Hervé Hope No, Hoppenot"), a French national who recently transitioned from CEO to advisor; Incyte owns the construction site across from 920 North King Street and is plugged into federal medical supply chains including VA/military health care interfaces.

Section: Wilmington Savings Fund Society / Wilmington Trust – claim that in 1990 most lower Delaware WSFS branches were sold to Wilmington Trust, founded by T. Coleman du Pont (French-American du Pont family); Wilmington Trust located at 1100 North Market Street, on Rodney Square, next to 1100 North King Street.

Section: 500 North Delaware Avenue – claim that the FBI has a presence in this building (which the source calls "another bank center"); also references MG+M Delaware Avenue law firm (Suite 200) sitting directly below the FBI suite (Suite 300) per the source.
Section: Wilmington LGBT/transgender services inventory – proximity list (Theater, "The Queen," Wilmington University LGBTQ programs, Transition Delaware LLC, plastic surgeons).

sub_items.description: Map showing 920 North King Street and surrounding blocks, including reference to a long red crane at a construction site across the street (1100 North King).
Map showing Bracebridge Complex at 1100 North King Street spanning six connected buildings, and the adjacent 1100 North Market Street / Rodney Square.

Local coverage quote from Miriam Deed: "I just feel like I don't understand why we're doing this without there being more accountability."

claims.label: Candace Owens publicly claims Macron-authorized assassination plot
claims.claim: On November 25, 2025, Candace Owens publicly stated via X that a high-ranking French government employee claimed the Macrons had executed upon and paid for her assassination, with the green light given to a GIGN team including one Israeli operative, and that Charlie Kirk's assassin trained with the French Foreign Legion's 13th Brigade.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the underlying source communication; verify the identity and position of the French government contact; cross-check with FBI/Counterterrorism response records (FOIA where possible).

claims.label: Pavel Durov endorses plausibility of French involvement claims
claims.claim: Telegram founder Pavel Durov publicly stated that after reviewing Charlie Kirk's prior comments about Macron's France, he finds Candace Owens's information about French involvement in Kirk's death entirely plausible.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate original Durov X post (date, full context) and verify any prior Durov statements about the 300% tariff framing.

claims.label: Ponton frames Safari Club precedent as supporting plausibility
claims.claim: Per the article by Freddie Ponton the host reads, the hesitation to dismiss Owens's allegations does not come from trust in her but from history; the host then says, from the Wikipedia page, that the Safari Club was a covert alliance of intelligence services formed in 1976.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Ponton's article URL; corroborate the Safari Club member list against declassified records; assess whether the Safari Club precedent materially maps onto the present allegations.

claims.label: Host Reads French Ministry Statement Denying Tyler Robinson FFL Service
claims.claim: Per a statement from the French Ministry of the Armed Forces that the host reads (as reported by France 24), Tyler Robinson was never part of the French Foreign Legion and could not have trained with it if he did not serve in an American military unit.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain original Ministry press release with date and spokesperson; cross-reference with Tyler Robinson's known background; verify the formal French position via Élysée or Ministry press archives.

claims.label: Host Reads Article Saying Camp Riley Typo Identified and Camp Ripley Confirmed
claims.claim: Per a France 24 article the host reads, which quotes Andy Parrish on X, a Camp Riley does not exist in Minnesota and Camp Ripley is the correct name; the host says her own X post contained the typo.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm Camp Ripley as the relevant installation; identify whether Minot AFB personnel participated in a Camp Ripley exercise in late August 2025 via official press releases.

claims.label: France 24 confirms California FFL training; denies Camp Riley Minnesota exercise
claims.claim: A France 24 article reports that the French Ministry of the Armed Forces confirmed the August 2–25, 2025 California FFL training exercise and formally denied a follow-on exercise at a "Camp Riley" in Minnesota, noting no such camp exists.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate original France 24 article; verify whether the Ministry's denial extends to any Camp Ripley exercise or only to "Camp Riley" as named.

claims.label: Host Says Operation Bright Star Ran August 29 to September 10, 2025
claims.claim: The host says Operation Bright Star, a bi-annual US-Egypt joint military operation in Cairo, ran August 29 through September 10, 2025, ending the day of the Charlie Kirk assassination.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Operation Bright Star 2025 dates via US Central Command or Egyptian military press releases; confirm exercise scope and participating units.

claims.label: Six French Foreign Legion regiments changed command in mid-August 2025
claims.claim: An article dated August 20, 2025 reported a change of command across six French Foreign Legion regiments in mid-August 2025.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate original article; obtain official command-change notices; identify the six regiments and whether any are the 2nd Foreign Infantry Regiment.

claims.label: French Street Name Dates From 1790s Refugee Settlement
claims.claim: Per a source email, North French Street in Wilmington, Delaware originated in the 1790s when a cluster of French-speaking refugees from Haiti and the French Revolution settled along Willing Street, and the nickname French Street took over.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify via Wilmington city historical archives; corroborate the Thomas Willing grid and 1790s French/Haitian refugee settlement pattern with academic historical sources.

claims.label: Three federal agencies operate at 920 North King Street, Wilmington
claims.claim: The host says a source told her a foreign dignitary was escorted from the hangar to 920 North King Street in Wilmington, Delaware, which she says they learned and confirmed had three federal agencies working together in one building and also houses the attorneys filing her paperwork in the Brigitte lawsuit.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the specific federal agencies at 920 North King Street via public lease records; verify the attorneys-of-record for the Macron v. Owens Delaware filing and their physical address.

claims.label: Bank of America vacated Bracebridge Complex in 2018
claims.claim: Per the source email and an article the host shows, Bank of America pulled out of a few of the Bracebridge Complex buildings in 2018 and left it completely empty.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Bank of America's Bracebridge exit via Wilmington business filings or news archives; obtain Miriam Deed comment context (which public meeting or hearing).

claims.label: Pierre S. du Pont founded Longwood Foundation
claims.claim: Per the source email, the Longwood Foundation was founded by Pierre S. du Pont, a member of the French-American du Pont family descended from Pierre Samuel du Pont de Nemours.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Longwood Foundation founding date and founder via IRS Form 990 filings and du Pont family genealogical records.

claims.label: 2024 legislation provided support to Longwood Foundation
claims.claim: Per the source email, 2024 legislation was passed to provide financial support to the Longwood Foundation to function as an educational center at the Bracebridge Complex.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the specific Delaware legislation; obtain bill text and legislative history.

claims.label: Hervé Hoppenot served as long-time CEO of Incyte
claims.claim: Per the source email the host reads, Hervé Hoppenot, a French national, was the long-time CEO of Incyte and seems to have just exited as CEO but is still running the company as advisor to the CEO.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Incyte CEO succession records via SEC filings; confirm Hoppenot's nationality and dates of service.

claims.label: T. Coleman du Pont founded Wilmington Trust
claims.claim: Per the source email, T. Coleman du Pont founded the Wilmington Trust, which in 1990 acquired most lower-Delaware branches of Wilmington Savings Fund Society (WSFS).
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Wilmington Trust founding date and founder via corporate filings and historical records; cross-check the 1990 WSFS branch transfer.

claims.investigative_direction: Identify the FBI tenant at 500 Delaware Avenue via federal lease records; confirm MG+M Delaware Avenue's suite location.

claims.claim: Per the Ace Partners website, the firm's mission is to identify, invest in, and support startups in aerospace and defense technology with a specific focus on Israel.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the current Ace Partners portfolio and confirm Satys as a portfolio company; cross-reference Israeli corporate registry.
